components.$comment: The kit's standalone IIC/I2C/TWI serial interface adapter module ('LCD controller 1602 transfer'). Renders as the bare PCF8574 board; ALL 16 header pins must be wired pin-for-pin to a bare LCD1602 (missing/crossed wires leave it blank, like real hardware) and GND/VCC/SDA/SCL to the MCU. ProtocolParts finds the fully-wired LCD and drives it, so LiquidCrystal_I2C sketches work out of the box.
